patchHistory.title: Twink Balance, Foods & Item Stat Adjustments
patchHistory.summary: Custom scaling adjustments for level 19 & 29 twinking, food buffs, profession constraints, and faction filtering.
changes: Food Buffs Expansion: Added Sagefish Delight (+6 MP5, Req Lvl 25), Soothing Turtle Bisque (+8 Sta, +8 Spi), Dragonbreath Chili, and Rumsey Rum Black Label.
Auto-BiS Food Optimization: BiS engine now tests and selects the highest-value food buff per spec and level bracket.
The Stockade: Confirmed Alliance capital city dungeon. Drops strictly filtered out for Horde characters.
Polished Driftwood Icon: Enforced Enchanting profession requirement (BoP crafted relic).
Totem of Charged Flames: Accessible for Horde Shamans in Ragefire Chasm.
Shaman Talents: Two-Handed Axes and Maces accessible with 1 point in Enhancement.
Windfury Weapon: Custom AP bonus and proc scaling applied for sub-40 ranks.

patchHistory.title: Dungeon Drop Rates & Twink Normalization
patchHistory.summary: Normalization of dungeon item level requirements and BoE world drops.
changes: Shadowfang Keep: Assassin's Blade and Shadowfang drop rates verified.
Blackfathom Deeps: Strike of the Hydra normalized for Level 27+.
Warsong Gulch: Level 18 PvP reputation rewards available at Friendly/Honored.
